business_problem: EY needed its global service desk to handle more than a million tickets a year without forcing agents across 30 service desks to spend time on repetitive note-taking and manual context gathering.
solution_summary: EY needed its global service desk to handle more than a million tickets a year without forcing agents across 30 service desks to spend time on repetitive note-taking and manual context gathering. EY implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Now Assist, and AI Agent. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Now Assist adds generative search, summarization, and drafting; AI Agent automates note generation and support assistance. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by Now Assist and AI Agent before ServiceNow AI Platform routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform. Running employee support and operational workflows on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier. EY estimates 160,000 hours and US$5.
